implementation.name: original-v2-pipeline-parallelism
implementation.scope: Original GPipe four-stage four-microbatch forward-then-backward trace; activation presence, no byte or measured-time model.
implementation.question: What stays in memory while the pipeline fills and drains?

purpose: Make dependencies and activation retention through bubbles visible.
storyboard: Complete each original equal time slot, saving an activation at forward completion.
Retain each activation through later columns until its matching backward completes.
Drain the reversed backward schedule and release all activations.
guard: Canonical F time=s+m; B time=13-s-m. Each stage eight busy/six idle slots. No early backward, byte estimate, or performance extrapolation.
